questions: Can we reverse edges multiple times, and does each reversal toggle the direction of all edges (so two reversals return to original orientation)?
Is the reversal operation allowed at any time, including when no outgoing edge exists from the current vertex in the current orientation?
Does moving along a directed edge require that the edge exists in the current orientation (after any reversals) from the current vertex?
If we are at vertex N, do we stop immediately, or must we finish the current operation/step?
Are self-loops (u_i = v_i) allowed, and if so, can moving along them keep us at the same vertex?
Is the graph simple (no multiple edges between same ordered pair), or can there be parallel edges?
Does the reversal operation have any effect if performed consecutively without moving in between?
Is the cost X for reversal applied per reversal, regardless of how many edges are reversed?
